sloka: तद्धि पूर्वम् नरश्रेष्ठ दत्तम् सदसि दैवतैः ।अप्रमेय बलम् घोरम् मखे परम भास्वरम् ॥१-३१-८॥
transliteration: taddhi pūrvam naraśreṣṭha dattam sadasi daivataiḥ ।aprameya balam ghoram makhe parama bhāsvaram ॥1-31-8॥

translations.english: O best among men, this bow of immeasurable energy. dreadful and highly lustrous was bestowed on king Janaka by devatas in a sacrificial assembly in the past.
